A cinematic fantasy portrait of an original young woman standing near the center of the frame, cropped from the thighs up, facing the camera. Long, wavy chestnut-brown hair falls past her shoulders with lighter highlights where the light catches it. She wears a fitted, semi-sheer blue bodice with an embossed frost-like pattern and long, translucent sleeves. A high collar holds a jeweled choker and a layered pendant necklace, with small drop earrings. Her expression is calm and direct, with softly parted lips. Behind her, towering blue ice crystals fill the background, softly out of focus. Soft, directional backlight outlines her hair and shoulders in a faint glow. Cool, saturated palette of icy blues, deep indigo, and silver, with warm skin tones for contrast. Subtle film grain and shallow depth of field give it a film-still quality. Regal, mysterious, and wintry, in the style of a fantasy book cover or winter-themed editorial.
